terms.grammar: pluteus, pluteī m., with the genitive plural of calceus
terms.comment: A description of ours: no reference work has a word for a shoe rack (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini, and Lewis & Short were searched). Pluteus is a shelf (see shelf) and calceus a shoe.

phrases.latin: Calceōs exue et in pluteō calceōrum repōne.
phrases.english: Take your shoes off and put them back on the shoe rack.

phrases.latin: Ubi sunt soccī tuī? — In pluteō calceōrum.
phrases.english: Where are your slippers? — On the shoe rack.

sources: Lewis & Short: pluteus · Lewis & Short: calceus
